description: Change a Design Studio project's order quantity, target region, contents size (boxes — enables right-sizing), name or performance floor (corrugated: ECT; folding cartons: bending stiffness in mN·m; rigid packs: top-load kgf). Free — no Suite run; a new quantity re-prices the existing bill of materials. Use it when the user gives the real volume before comparing options or requesting quotes.

contents_mm.description: Boxes: the product(s) as packed, 'L x W x H' in mm (3 balls of 74 mm in a row: '74 x 74 x 222'). Enables right-sizing.

performance.description: Performance floor — use the pair that fits the pack. Downgauging is checked against the floor only when both current and required are given.

stiffness_current.description: Folding carton: current board bending stiffness, mN·m

stiffness_required.description: Folding carton: minimum bending stiffness, mN·m

name: update_project
title: Design Studio: update a project
